body.query: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT LEFT(date, 4)::INT AS year,
       SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth
GROUP BY LEFT(date, 4)
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;
raw_response.query: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

reason.answer: The query returns a single row with two columns: the calendar year and the total gas consumption recorded for that year. It is designed to identify which year had the highest aggregated consumption across all customers and months in the dataset.
reason.business:
- Group all recorded monthly consumption figures by calendar year.
- Sum the consumption amounts within each year to get an annual total.
- Rank the years by their total consumption in descending order.
- Return the single year with the highest total consumption.
reason.technical:
## Common Table Expressions
- (not used)
## Projected Columns
- Year derived from the leading four characters of the monthly period label.
- Summed consumption across all customers and months within each year.
## Source
- Monthly consumption records covering customers and year-month periods.
## Joins
- (not used) — the monthly consumption source already carries the period and amount needed.
## Filters
- (not used) — all available months are included so the annual totals are complete.
## Aggregation
- Group by the derived year and compute the total consumption per year.
## Sorting
- Order years by total consumption descending so the leading year appears first.
## Result Limit
- Limit to one row to return only the top-consuming year.
## Union
- (not used)
